title: "05 序列捕获偏倚诊断"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- CAPTURE_BIAS_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- CAPTURE_BIAS_TAB
prepare_module_outputs(OUTPUT_FIG_DIR, OUTPUT_TAB_DIR, c("01_pair_shift", "02_pair_consistency", "03_sequence_properties"))
activate_serum_context(environment(), analysis_scope = "method_comparison")
if (!pkg_has("edgeR") || !pkg_has("patchwork")) stop("模块 05 需要 edgeR 和 patchwork。")
library(patchwork)
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
pandora_paired_rows <- sample_info %>%
  filter(as.character(Method) %in% c("1", "2"), !is.na(PairID), PairID != "")
pandora_pair_membership <- table(pandora_paired_rows$PairID, as.character(pandora_paired_rows$Method))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- nrow(pandora_paired_rows) == 6L &&
  identical(dim(pandora_pair_membership), c(3L, 2L)) && all(pandora_pair_membership == 1L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")

```

# 分析边界

本模块用序列本身的长度、GC、末端碱基、RNA 类别和丰度描述方法 2 相对方法 1 的捕获偏移，不把序列属性关联解释为分子机制。

```{r prepare-logcpm, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
capture_samples <- sample_info %>%
  filter(as.character(Method) %in% c("1", "2"), PairID != "") %>%
  mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample), Method = as.character(Method)) %>%
  arrange(PairID, Method)
sample_order <- capture_samples$Sample

sequence_long <- output_all %>%
  filter(
    Sample %in% sample_order, !is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "", Reads > 0,
    !Sequence %in% spikein_edit1_sequences(SPIKEIN_SEQ)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample), Sequence = as.character(Sequence), Reads,
    FeatureCategory = as.character(FeatureCategory), PrimaryAnnotation = as.character(PrimaryAnnotation)
  )

sequence_meta <- sequence_long %>%
  group_by(Sequence) %>%
  summarise(
    FeatureCategory = first(FeatureCategory),
    TopAnnotation = first(PrimaryAnnotation),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Length = nchar(Sequence),
    GCPercent = 100 * str_count(Sequence, "[GC]") / Length,
    FivePrimeBase = substr(Sequence, 1, 1),
    ThreePrimeBase = substr(Sequence, Length, Length)
  )

matrix_info <- build_feature_count_matrix(
  sequence_long %>% transmute(Sample, Feature = Sequence, Reads),
  feature_col = "Feature", sample_order = sample_order, min_total = 5
)
sequence_counts <- round(matrix_info$matrix)
dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = sequence_counts)
dge <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
sequence_cpm <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = FALSE)
sequence_logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 0.5)

mean_logcpm <- rowMeans(sequence_logcpm)
abundance_breaks <- unique(stats::quantile(mean_logcpm, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE))
abundance_quartile <- if (length(abundance_breaks) >= 3) {
  cut(mean_logcpm, breaks = abundance_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
} else {
  rep(1L, length(mean_logcpm))
}
sequence_meta <- sequence_meta %>%
  filter(Sequence %in% rownames(sequence_logcpm)) %>%
  mutate(
    OverallMeanLogCPM = unname(mean_logcpm[Sequence]),
    AbundanceQuartile = paste0("Q", unname(abundance_quartile[match(Sequence, rownames(sequence_logcpm))])),
    GCQuartile = cut(GCPercent, breaks = c(-Inf, 25, 50, 75, Inf), labels = c("0-25%", "25-50%", "50-75%", "75-100%"))
  )

sequence_capture_path <- file.path(CAPTURE_TAB, "05_sequence", "capture_results_method2_vs_method1.csv")
if (!file.exists(sequence_capture_path)) {
  stop("模块 05 需要先完成模块 04：", sequence_capture_path)
}
sequence_significance <- readr::read_csv(sequence_capture_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    Sequence = as.character(Feature), OverallPairedLog2FC = logFC, OverallPairedFDR = FDR,
    OverallPairedSignificant = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05 & abs(logFC) >= log2(1.5)
  )
sequence_meta <- sequence_meta %>% left_join(sequence_significance, by = "Sequence")
```

```{r paired-shifts, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
pair_specs <- capture_samples %>%
  select(PairID, Method, Sample) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Sample, names_prefix = "Method") %>%
  arrange(PairID)

paired_capture_logfc <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(pair_specs)), function(i) {
  pair_id <- pair_specs$PairID[[i]]
  sample1 <- pair_specs$Method1[[i]]
  sample2 <- pair_specs$Method2[[i]]
  tibble(
    Sequence = rownames(sequence_logcpm), PairID = pair_id,
    Method1Sample = sample1, Method2Sample = sample2,
    Method1CPM = sequence_cpm[, sample1], Method2CPM = sequence_cpm[, sample2],
    Method1LogCPM = sequence_logcpm[, sample1], Method2LogCPM = sequence_logcpm[, sample2],
    MeanLogCPM = 0.5 * (Method1LogCPM + Method2LogCPM),
    PairLog2FC = Method2LogCPM - Method1LogCPM,
    DetectedBothCPM1 = Method1CPM >= 1 & Method2CPM >= 1
  )
}) %>%
  left_join(sequence_meta, by = "Sequence")
write_csv_safe(paired_capture_logfc, "paired_capture_logfc.csv")
```

```{r consistency, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
pair_logfc_wide <- paired_capture_logfc %>%
  select(Sequence, PairID, PairLog2FC, DetectedBothCPM1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = PairID, values_from = c(PairLog2FC, DetectedBothCPM1))

pair_ids <- pair_specs$PairID
pair_combinations <- combn(pair_ids, 2, simplify = FALSE)
significance_lookup <- sequence_meta$OverallPairedSignificant[match(pair_logfc_wide$Sequence, sequence_meta$Sequence)]
significance_lookup[is.na(significance_lookup)] <- FALSE
capture_pair_consistency <- map_dfr(pair_combinations, function(pair_pair) {
  p1 <- pair_pair[[1]]
  p2 <- pair_pair[[2]]
  x <- pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("PairLog2FC_", p1)]]
  y <- pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("PairLog2FC_", p2)]]
  detected <- pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("DetectedBothCPM1_", p1)]] & pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("DetectedBothCPM1_", p2)]]
  significant_detected <- detected & significance_lookup
  tibble(
    PairA = p1, PairB = p2, SharedSequenceN = sum(detected, na.rm = TRUE),
    LogFCSpearman = safe_cor(x[detected], y[detected]),
    DirectionConcordancePct = if_else(sum(detected, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, 100 * mean(sign(x[detected]) == sign(y[detected]), na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    MedianAbsoluteDifference = if_else(sum(detected, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, median(abs(x[detected] - y[detected]), na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    OverallSignificantSequenceN = sum(significant_detected, na.rm = TRUE),
    SignificantDirectionConcordancePct = if_else(
      sum(significant_detected, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      100 * mean(sign(x[significant_detected]) == sign(y[significant_detected]), na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_
    ),
    SignificanceDefinition = "paired edgeR FDR<0.05 and |log2FC|>=log2(1.5)"
  )
})

all_pair_detected <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(pair_ids, function(id) pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("DetectedBothCPM1_", id)]]))
all_pair_signs <- sapply(pair_ids, function(id) sign(pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("PairLog2FC_", id)]]))
all_pair_direction_concordance <- if (sum(all_pair_detected, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  100 * mean(apply(all_pair_signs[all_pair_detected, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) length(unique(x)) == 1))
} else NA_real_
all_pair_significant <- all_pair_detected & significance_lookup
all_pair_significant_concordance <- if (sum(all_pair_significant, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  100 * mean(apply(all_pair_signs[all_pair_significant, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) length(unique(x)) == 1))
} else NA_real_
capture_pair_consistency <- bind_rows(
  capture_pair_consistency,
  tibble(
    PairA = "all_three_pairs", PairB = "all_three_pairs",
    SharedSequenceN = sum(all_pair_detected, na.rm = TRUE), LogFCSpearman = NA_real_,
    DirectionConcordancePct = all_pair_direction_concordance,
    MedianAbsoluteDifference = NA_real_,
    OverallSignificantSequenceN = sum(all_pair_significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    SignificantDirectionConcordancePct = all_pair_significant_concordance,
    SignificanceDefinition = "paired edgeR FDR<0.05 and |log2FC|>=log2(1.5)"
  )
)
write_csv_safe(capture_pair_consistency, "capture_pair_consistency.csv")
```

```{r feature-summary, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
summarise_bias <- function(df, property, property_type) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[property]]), as.character(.data[[property]]) != "") %>%
    group_by(Value = .data[[property]]) %>%
    summarise(
      ObservationN = n(), SequenceN = n_distinct(Sequence),
      MedianLog2FC = median(PairLog2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
      MedianAbsLog2FC = median(abs(PairLog2FC), na.rm = TRUE),
      Method2HigherPct = 100 * mean(PairLog2FC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Property = property_type, Value = as.character(Value))
}

bias_summary_input <- paired_capture_logfc %>%
  filter(pmax(Method1CPM, Method2CPM) >= 1)
if (nrow(bias_summary_input) == 0) stop("没有任一方 CPM≥1 的 pair–sequence 观测，无法进行捕获偏倚分层。")

capture_bias_feature_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarise_bias(bias_summary_input, "Length", "length_nt"),
  summarise_bias(bias_summary_input, "GCQuartile", "gc_quartile"),
  summarise_bias(bias_summary_input, "FivePrimeBase", "five_prime_base"),
  summarise_bias(bias_summary_input, "ThreePrimeBase", "three_prime_base"),
  summarise_bias(bias_summary_input, "FeatureCategory", "rna_annotation_class"),
  summarise_bias(bias_summary_input, "AbundanceQuartile", "abundance_quartile")
) %>%
  mutate(EligibilityDefinition = "either method CPM>=1 within pair") %>%
  select(Property, Value, EligibilityDefinition, everything())
write_csv_safe(capture_bias_feature_summary, "capture_bias_feature_summary.csv")
```

```{r figures, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
p_ma <- paired_capture_logfc %>%
  filter(pmax(Method1CPM, Method2CPM) >= 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(MeanLogCPM, PairLog2FC)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.18, size = 0.8, color = serum_blue) +
  facet_wrap(~PairID, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Sequence capture shifts across three matched aliquot pairs",
    subtitle = "Sequences with CPM >= 1 in either method; positive values favor method 2",
    x = "Mean TMM logCPM", y = "Method 2 - method 1 log2FC"
  ) +
  serum_theme_bw()
save_plot_nested(p_ma, "01_pair_shift", "paired_sequence_capture_ma.pdf", width = 12, height = 4.8, view = REPORT_VIEW)

consistency_plot_df <- map_dfr(pair_combinations, function(pair_pair) {
  p1 <- pair_pair[[1]]; p2 <- pair_pair[[2]]
  tibble(
    PairA = p1, PairB = p2,
    X = pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("PairLog2FC_", p1)]],
    Y = pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("PairLog2FC_", p2)]],
    Keep = pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("DetectedBothCPM1_", p1)]] & pair_logfc_wide[[paste0("DetectedBothCPM1_", p2)]]
  ) %>% filter(Keep)
})
p_consistency <- ggplot(consistency_plot_df, aes(X, Y)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.18, size = 0.8, color = serum_green) +
  facet_wrap(~paste(PairA, "vs", PairB), scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Sequence log2FC agreement between matched pairs",
    subtitle = "Sequences with CPM >= 1 in both methods of both compared pairs",
    x = "Pair A log2FC", y = "Pair B log2FC"
  ) +
  serum_theme_bw()
save_plot_nested(p_consistency, "02_pair_consistency", "capture_pair_logfc_consistency.pdf", width = 11, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)

p_length <- capture_bias_feature_summary %>%
  filter(Property == "length_nt", as.numeric(Value) >= 15, as.numeric(Value) <= 45) %>%
  mutate(Length = as.numeric(Value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Length, MedianLog2FC)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_line(color = serum_blue, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = SequenceN), color = serum_blue, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5)) +
  labs(title = "Stratified by length", x = "Sequence length (nt)", y = "Median paired log2FC", size = "Sequences") +
  serum_theme_bw()

p_ends <- capture_bias_feature_summary %>%
  filter(Property %in% c("five_prime_base", "three_prime_base")) %>%
  mutate(Property = recode(Property, five_prime_base = "5-prime base", three_prime_base = "3-prime base")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Value, MedianLog2FC, fill = Value)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Property) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(A = "#009E73", C = "#0072B2", G = "#E69F00", T = "#D55E00", N = serum_neutral_line), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Stratified by terminal base", x = NULL, y = "Median paired log2FC") +
  serum_theme_bw()

p_gc_abundance <- capture_bias_feature_summary %>%
  filter(Property %in% c("gc_quartile", "abundance_quartile")) %>%
  mutate(
    Property = recode(Property, gc_quartile = "GC stratum", abundance_quartile = "Abundance quartile"),
    Value = factor(Value, levels = c("0-25%", "25-50%", "50-75%", "75-100%", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Value, MedianLog2FC, fill = Property)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Property, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("GC stratum" = serum_green, "Abundance quartile" = serum_orange)) +
  labs(title = "Stratified by GC and abundance", x = NULL, y = "Median paired log2FC") +
  serum_theme_bw()

p_class <- capture_bias_feature_summary %>%
  filter(Property == "rna_annotation_class") %>%
  slice_max(SequenceN, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Value = reorder(Value, MedianLog2FC)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(MedianLog2FC, Value, size = SequenceN)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_point(color = serum_purple, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  labs(title = "RNA annotation category", x = "Median paired log2FC", y = NULL, size = "Sequences") +
  serum_theme_bw()

save_plot_nested(
  ((p_length | p_ends) / (p_gc_abundance | p_class)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(subtitle = "CPM >= 1 in either method within each pair; positive values favor method 2 capture"),
  "03_sequence_properties", "capture_bias_sequence_properties.pdf",
  width = 12, height = 10, view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

这些图只说明捕获偏移是否随可观测序列属性而变化。它们不能区分连接、逆转录、扩增、RNA 修饰或其他具体机制。
